meta.name: MitraBank Syariah - Islamic Landing Page
meta.description:
A clean, modern, and professional landing page UI concept for a Sharia banking institution (MitraBank Syariah). This design is structured to build trust and highlight key financial products like Murabahah and Ijarah.


Key Features:

- Fully responsive layouts (Desktop, Tablet, and Mobile versions).

- Built entirely using Figma Auto Layout for clean and scalable structures.

- Includes Hero section, App promotion, Product Cards, Features (Why Choose Us), and Testimonials.


Feel free to duplicate to see the Auto Layout structure, and leave a ❤️ if you find it helpful!
